data.title: Aurelia
data.summary: Identity, packaging language and a website for a natural skincare brand.
data.lead: A complete brand and website for a skincare label that wanted warmth, clarity and a quieter kind of luxury.
data.challenge_title: Stand out on a crowded shelf.
data.challenge: Aurelia makes natural skincare for people who read labels. They needed a name, a look and a website that felt considered and calm without sliding into the clichés of the category.
data.approach: We built the identity around a refined serif wordmark, a deep amber palette and generous space, then carried it through packaging and a website that puts the ingredients first.
data.deliverables:
Brand strategy
Visual identity system
Packaging design direction
Website design and development
Brand guidelines

data.title: Solara Retreats
data.summary: A brand and booking website for a collection of design-led retreats.
data.lead: A brand and website for a small group of retreats that are built into their landscapes.
data.challenge: Solara's retreats are remote and beautiful, but their old website treated them like any hotel listing. They needed a brand that sells atmosphere before amenities.
data.approach: We let photography lead, set a quiet type system around it and designed a booking journey that keeps the first screen free of clutter.
data.deliverables:
Brand strategy
Visual identity system
Website design and development
Photography art direction
Launch support

data.title: Pattern
data.summary: A bold identity and printed books for a design and architecture practice.
data.lead: An identity and a set of printed pieces for a practice that designs spaces, people and purpose.
data.challenge: Pattern's work is thoughtful, but its materials looked like everyone else's. They wanted a mark and a printed system that could carry a point of view on the cover alone.
data.approach: A single vermilion form became the signature. We paired it with a plain, tightly set typeface and applied it across covers, stationery and signage.
data.deliverables:
Brand strategy
Visual identity system
Book and print design
Brand guidelines
Assets for digital and print

data.title: Fora
data.summary: Packaging and identity for a plant-based wellness range.
data.lead: Packaging and a brand system for a plant-based wellness range.
data.challenge: Fora's products are simple and honest. The packaging needed to feel premium and be clear about what is inside, without relying on green leaves.
data.approach: We designed a deep green box with a delicate embossed mark, a short set of clear labels and a palette taken from stone and moss.
data.deliverables:
Brand strategy
Visual identity system
Packaging design
Print production support
Brand guidelines

data.title: Velra
data.summary: A brand and mobile-first website for a boutique stays collection.
data.lead: A brand and a mobile-first website for extraordinary places for a calmer tomorrow.
data.challenge_title: Win guests on a small screen.
data.challenge: Most of Velra's guests discover it on their phones. The website had to feel as considered on a handset as the places themselves.
data.approach: We started with the mobile layout, set the headline type large and let a single photograph carry each page before scaling the system up to desktop.
data.deliverables:
Brand strategy
Visual identity system
Mobile-first website design
Development and CMS setup
Launch support

data.title: Common Ground
data.summary: A brand and website for a hospitality brand built around people and place.
data.lead: A complete brand and website for a hospitality brand dedicated to people, place and a more considered way of travelling.
data.challenge_title: Bring a meaningful vision to life.
data.challenge: Common Ground set out to create a collection of stays that connect people with nature and local communities. They needed a brand and digital presence that could capture this vision with clarity, warmth and a sense of place.
data.approach_title: A refined identity rooted in place.
data.approach: We developed a visual identity and website that reflects Common Ground's values — thoughtful design, local connection and a lighter footprint. The result is a calm, confident brand that feels both contemporary and enduring.
data.deliverables:
Brand strategy
Visual identity system
Website design and development
Brand guidelines
Launch support
